title: jira-ado-sync configuration
description: Non-secret settings. Secrets are referenced by name and never stored in this file.

siteUrl.description: Base URL of the Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://example.atlassian.net

authMode.description: apiToken: API token of a dedicated service account.

apiTokenSetting.description: Name of the app setting or environment variable that holds the API token.

accountEmail.description: E-mail of the service account. Sent with the API token in basic authentication.

serviceAccountId.description: accountId of the service account. Its own changes are not echoed back.

webhookSecretSetting.description: Name of the app setting that holds the secret of the Jira webhook.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization name, not the full URL.

authMode.description: managedIdentity is recommended. pat is for local testing only.

patSetting.description: Name of the app setting that holds the PAT. Required when authMode is pat.

serviceIdentity.description: Unique name of the identity the sync writes as. Its own changes are not echoed back.

webhookUserSetting.description: Name of the app setting that holds the user name of the service hook's basic authentication.

webhookPasswordSetting.description: Name of the app setting that holds the password of the service hook's basic authentication.

features.description: Which fields are synced. Missing fields default to true.

jiraProject.description: Jira project key, e.g. PROJ. Must be unique across mappings.

areaPath.description: Area path for work items created from Jira, e.g. MyProject\Team A.

statusMap.description: Jira status name to ADO state name. Must be one-to-one.
